articles.title: Customer Passwords Don't Survive a Move to Shopify. Does It Still Matter?
articles.excerpt: If you've moved a store to Shopify, you've probably had this conversation with the client: "So every customer has to make a new account?" Shopify's own migration checklist is clear about why. It says…
articles.body: If you've moved a store to Shopify, you've probably had this conversation with the client: "So every customer has to make a new account?" Shopify's own migration checklist is clear about why. It says to "encourage your customers to sign up again if your store uses customer accounts. Because passwords are encrypted, only customer records are imported to Shopify." That makes sense. A properly stored password is a hash, and you can't move a hash between two systems that check passwords differently. So names, emails and addresses come across, and the passwords don't. The twist: Shopify's newer accounts don't need a password While reading up on this, I found that Shopify's newer customer accounts can work without passwords at all.
articles.author: Hannan Shoukat

articles.title: From One Image to a Game-Ready 3D Model: My Prototype Workflow with Idol Max

articles.body: I've been prototyping small game ideas in my spare time, and the slowest part is never the code — it's getting decent 3D assets into the engine while the idea is still fresh. Modeling software is great, but for early prototypes I recently started using a different approach: turning reference images directly into 3D models with %0A" rel="noopener noreferrer">Idol Max , a web tool that converts a single image into a game-ready GLB. The workflow is short: Upload one image. Get back a GLB with UVs and 2K textures. Optionally add a rig, preview it, and export a 360° GIF or MP4 to share with the team. A few things I appreciate as a developer: Engine-friendly output : the GLB drops straight into Three.js, Unity, or Godot without much cleanup.

articles.body: Originally published on the Solitaire: Klondike & Spider engineering log . If you shuffle a standard 52-card deck completely at random in Klondike or 4-suit Spider, a large fraction of deals are mathematically unwinnable before the player touches a single card. articles.title: Test Contact Deduplication Without Merging Different Buyers
articles.excerpt: In a B2B list, identical company domains do not mean identical people. The purchasing manager and a service engineer may share a domain while owning different decisions. Deduplication that merges them…
articles.body: In a B2B list, identical company domains do not mean identical people. The purchasing manager and a service engineer may share a domain while owning different decisions. Deduplication that merges them can erase the very distinction the sales team needs. Keep three separate outcomes: exact match, possible match, and separate contacts. An exact match can use an existing internal contact ID or the same verified email under your documented comparison rules. A possible match can use a shared domain and similar names, but should only enter a review queue. Do not remove plus tags or dots globally; address behavior differs across providers and organizations.

articles.body: SpaceX launched a batch of classified satellites this morning (Nov. 22), on the NROL-136 mission out of California. A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base's Launch Complex-4E at 7:23 a.m. ET (1223 GMT; 4:23 a.m. local time in California). It was the sixth National Reconnaissance Office launch (NROL) this year to deliver a payload, or group of payloads, to low Earth orbit , all which have been carried out by SpaceX 's workhorse Falcon 9. The launch marks another step in the NRO's effort to expand its intelligence-gathering capabilities through a proliferated network of spacecraft designed to provide more frequent and timely surveillance of locations around the globe. articles.body: On Nov. 22, 1989, the space shuttle Discovery launched on the secret mission STS-33 for the U.S. military. It lifted off from Kennedy Space Center and up into the dark of night. This was the third nighttime launch of the shuttle program and the 32nd shuttle mission overall. Discovery had five astronauts on board. Their mission was to deploy a classified payload for the U.S. Department of Defense. NASA and the military launched several secretive shuttle missions to deploy military satellites . The satellite that launched with STS-33 is believed to be a type of spy satellite called Magnum. But exactly what Magnum was doing in orbit remains classified. articles.title: 10 things that worry me about chasing the 2027 total solar eclipse in Egypt
articles.excerpt: The longest total solar eclipse on land this century promises to be the experience of a lifetime, but watching it from Luxor, Egypt, may not be straightforward. What could go wrong? Quite a lot, actua…
articles.body: On Aug. 2, 2027, I'll be in Luxor, Egypt, to witness what could be the greatest total solar eclipse of my life. I've seen nine total solar eclipses across the world, but this one promises to be different. For a remarkable six minutes and 22 seconds, the moon will completely cover the sun, plunging Egypt's ancient temples and monuments into eerie twilight as the solar corona bursts into view. I've been calling it the "eclipse of the century" for many years, and for good reason. It will be the longest total solar eclipse until 2114 — and the longest on land of the 21st century — and it will take place in one of the most extraordinary places on Earth. What could go wrong? I've chased eclipses long enough to know that the celestial mechanics are the easy part.
